title: Clear entire TSecBench board
description: Keep running until EVERY challenge from `pnpm tsecbench list` has is_completed=true. Loop: list → start incomplete (prefer medium) → exploit → submit → close. Max 3 concurrent containers. VPN already connected—never mutate host network/VPN/proxy. Do NOT assert_goal until the board is fully cleared. Final evidence MUST be evidence/tsec/ALL_COMPLETE.json: a JSON array of all challenges where every is_completed is true (gate will reject any false).

title: Maintain progress log
description: Keep evidence/goals/autonomous-progress.md updated with completed codes, scores, failures, next plan. Assert only at the end together with clear-board.
